_note: Derived from build/instrumented/sync_generator.manifest.json + address_decoder.manifest.json. All 11 currently-instrumented pins are mapped.

entries.description: Master clock output — stuck-low freezes all counters; stuck-high corrupts all timing
H_LO carry-out — fault prevents H_HI and V_LO from ever being enabled; kills all sync
H_HI carry-out — fault prevents V_LO from incrementing; VSYNC never fires
H_HI bit 3 → HSYNC NAND input A — fault widens or eliminates HSYNC pulse
H_HI bit 2 → HSYNC NAND input B — fault widens or eliminates HSYNC pulse
H_HI bit 1 → HSYNC NAND input C — fault widens or eliminates HSYNC pulse
V_LO bit 3 → VSYNC NAND input A — fault eliminates or locks VSYNC; vertical collapse
V_LO bit 2 → VSYNC NAND input B — fault eliminates or locks VSYNC; vertical collapse
Address bit A0 to decoder — stuck fault causes A0/A2 chip-selects to alias; ROM and POKEY respond at wrong addresses
Address bit A1 to decoder — stuck fault causes A1/A3 chip-selects to alias; RAM and EAROM respond at wrong addresses
